method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search
tools.description: Search Kestra plugins, docs, blueprints, or blogs. Returns matching results with highlights. Parameter 'query' is the search text. Optional 'type' must be one of: PLUGINS (default), DOCS, BLUEPRINTS, BLOGS.

type.description: one of: PLUGINS (default), DOCS, BLUEPRINTS, BLOGS

id.description: a unique ID for the document or search result item

tools.name: task_schema
tools.title: Task Schema
tools.description: Get the full schema/documentation for a specific Kestra task class. Returns properties schema, outputs schema and documentation. Parameter 'cls' is the full class name like 'io.kestra.plugin.core.log.Log'. Optional 'properties' must be one of: 'declared' (default, only properties declared by the task) or 'all' (also includes inherited properties).

properties.description: one of: 'declared' (default, only properties declared by the task) or 'all' (also includes inherited properties)

tools.name: list_plugins
tools.title: List Plugins
tools.description: List available Kestra plugins with summary info (name, title, group, description, categories, and counts per element type: taskCount, triggerCount, taskRunnerCount, storageCount, secretManagerCount, logExporterCount). Use this to discover what plugins exist. Filter by count > 0 to find plugins with a specific element type. Optional 'category' parameter filters by: AI, BUSINESS, CLOUD, CORE, DATA, INFRASTRUCTURE. Optional 'detail' parameter: 'full' (default) includes plugin descriptions, 'concise' omits them to save tokens.

detail.description: 'full' (default) includes plugin descriptions, 'concise' omits them to save tokens

category.description: filter by category: AI, BUSINESS, CLOUD, CORE, DATA, INFRASTRUCTURE

tools.name: plugin_tasks
tools.title: Plugin Tasks
tools.description: List all tasks and triggers for a specific Kestra plugin, grouped by subpackage. The 'plugin' parameter accepts a plugin name like 'plugin-aws' or 'core', or a group like 'io.kestra.plugin.aws'.

plugin.description: plugin name like 'plugin-aws' or 'core', or a group like 'io.kestra.plugin.aws'

tools.name: list_installed_versions
tools.title: Installed Plugin Versions
tools.description: List the currently installed version of each Kestra plugin. Shows each plugin's name, group, and version number. Optional 'plugin' parameter filters by plugin name (e.g. 'aws', 'gcp'). For the full GitHub release history of a plugin, use plugin_release_history instead.

tools.name: list_plugin_elements
tools.title: List Plugin Elements
tools.description: List all elements of one type across all Kestra plugins. 'elementType' must be one of: TASK_RUNNER (task runner backends, e.g. Kubernetes, GCP Batch, AWS Batch, Docker), TRIGGER (trigger types, e.g. Schedule, Webhook, Realtime variants, JDBC and message queue triggers), STORAGE (internal storage backends Kestra uses for internal state and outputs, e.g. GCS, S3, Azure Blob Storage, MinIO), SECRET_MANAGER (secret manager backends, e.g. HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, GCP Secret Manager, Azure Key Vault, 1Password, CyberArk, Doppler), LOG_EXPORTER (log shipper backends to ship execution logs to external systems), APP (Kestra App plugins), APP_BLOCK (building blocks used inside Apps), CHART (dashboard chart types), DATA_FILTER (dashboard data filters), DATA_FILTER_KPI (dashboard KPI data filters), ADDITIONAL_PLUGIN (miscellaneous plugin classes not covered by another element type). Each entry includes FQCN, title, description, and the owning plugin name/group. Always call this tool when asked what backends of a given type are available -- do NOT guess plugin names. Optional 'detail' parameter: 'full' (default) includes element descriptions, 'concise' omits them to save tokens.

detail.description: 'full' (default) includes element descriptions, 'concise' omits them to save tokens

elementType.description: one of: TASK_RUNNER, TRIGGER, STORAGE, SECRET_MANAGER, LOG_EXPORTER, APP, APP_BLOCK, CHART, DATA_FILTER, DATA_FILTER_KPI, ADDITIONAL_PLUGIN

tools.name: plugin_release_history
tools.title: Plugin Release History
tools.description: Get the full release history of a Kestra plugin from GitHub, including which Kestra version each release targets. Parameter 'plugin' is the repo name: plugins are 'plugin-aws', 'plugin-gcp', while storage backends, secret managers and log data stores have their own repositories, e.g. 'storage-gcs', 'secret-vault', 'log-data-store-splunk'. A bare name is prefixed with 'plugin-'. Optional 'limit' sets max releases to return (default: 10, max: 20). For the currently installed version of each plugin, use list_installed_versions instead.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.title: Search Docs
tools.description: Search Kestra documentation pages by keyword. Returns matching pages with their parsedUrl and title. Optional parameter 'version' targets a specific Kestra version (e.g. 'v0.23'); defaults to the current installed version.

version.description: Kestra version like 'v0.23'; defaults to the current installed version

tools.name: get_doc
tools.title: Get Doc Page
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown content and metadata for a Kestra documentation page. Pass either the parsedUrl path (e.g. 'docs/getting-started') from search_docs, or a docId. If the identifier contains a '/' it is treated as a path first; otherwise a docId lookup is attempted. Optional parameter 'version' targets a specific Kestra version (e.g. 'v0.23'); defaults to the current installed version.

version.description: Kestra version like 'v0.23'; defaults to the current installed version

pathOrDocId.description: the parsedUrl path (e.g. 'docs/getting-started') or docId of the page

tools.name: list_doc_children
tools.title: List Doc Children
tools.description: List all documentation pages under a given path prefix, ordered by their navigation order. Returns each child's parsedUrl and metadata. Parameter 'path' is the parent path prefix (e.g. 'docs/getting-started'). Optional parameter 'version' targets a specific Kestra version (e.g. 'v0.23'); defaults to the current installed version.

version.description: Kestra version like 'v0.23'; defaults to the current installed version

tools.name: search_blueprints
tools.title: Search Blueprints
tools.description: Search Kestra flow blueprints -- ready-made flow templates. Returns matching blueprints with id, title, description, tags, includedTasks (FQCNs), and ee (Enterprise Edition flag). Optional parameters: 'query' (search text), 'tags' (comma-separated), 'types' (comma-separated FQCNs to filter by includedTasks -- use list_plugin_elements to get valid FQCNs), 'page' (default: 1), 'size' (results per page, default: 10).

types.description: comma-separated FQCNs to filter by includedTasks; use list_plugin_elements to get valid FQCNs

tools.name: get_blueprint_flow
tools.title: Get Blueprint Flow
tools.description: Get the full YAML flow definition for a specific Kestra blueprint. Parameter 'id' is the blueprint ID from the search_blueprints tool.

id.description: the blueprint id from the search_blueprints tool
